description: 电商问数评测集（骨架，样例待填充）

cases.query: 上个月华北地区的GMV是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id WHERE dr.region_name = '华北' AND fo.date_id BETWEEN 20250201 AND 20250228
